name: Crowded-long fragility fade — high funding + OI expansion at range top (short, 1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: same crowded-long fragility thesis as the band-stretch fade, but read on a faster 1h clock and using range_position (price near the top of its recent range) as the over-extension gauge instead of a band z-score — a different crowding read that catches the fade at local range highs. High funding_rate (top decile) + EXPANDING open_interest means longs are crowded and bleeding carry; range_position near 1 says price is pinned at the top where the marginal leveraged buyer is exhausted. We short (direction -1) and receive the positive funding carry (funding_feature). Hold ~0.25-0.75d, faster than the 4h version. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if the OI-expansion filter can be dropped without hurting the edge — then it is just shorting strength into a pinned-high-funding trend and gets run over. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if it is indistinguishable from a plain range-top short with no funding/OI condition, or if maxDD > 25%.
catalyst: high funding + rising open interest with price at the top of its range — crowded longs to fade short.
